purpose: Collect original-image candidates; no method outputs or manual pixel labels used

settings.saturated_red: loose AND S>=75 AND R>=1.25*G AND R>=1.25*B
settings.per_book: up to 2 saturated and 2 loose/dark candidates, separating sorted page indices by max(2,N//20)
settings.caveat: Color-based purposive screening, not a representative or unbiased benchmark. Faint thin red may be missed.
